result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where content is obscured by the bottom navigation, and one minor carousel clipping issue on the right edge.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making part of the content hard to see and likely inaccessible without extra scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last items clear the fixed tab bar.

issues.description: The rightmost item in the horizontal restaurant carousel is visibly clipped at the screen edge, which makes the section look a bit truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add a small end gutter or adjust the carousel spacing so partially visible cards look intentional and don’t appear cut off.
